title: Plan a first Go release from an explicit baseline without creating tags
prompt: Adopt monochange for this Go module. It has never had a release tag; use 1.2.0 as the starting release baseline. Record a patch for a corrected error message and show the pending 1.2.1 plan. Do not create any tags or invent a version field in go.mod. Record the changeset and verify the preview, but leave changesets pending and manifests at their current versions. Do not publish, tag, commit, or contact a hosted provider.
expectation: The Go adapter resolves its own version from tags regardless of the optional version_source override. The owner has tag = true and an explicit initial_version, so an untagged repository still plans a nonempty release. Planning needs no tags, registry calls, or synthetic manifest version.

checks.why: A completed adoption or update leaves a repository configuration.
The configuration and pending changesets must be accepted by the real CLI.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; const c=JSON.parse(cli(["config","--format","json"])).config; assert.equal(c.packages.length,1); assert.equal(c.packages[0].package_type,"go"); assert.equal(c.packages[0].initial_version,"1.2.0"); assert.equal(c.packages[0].tag,true);'
checks.why: The Go adapter intrinsically resolves versions from tags; tag enablement and initial_version provide an untagged first-release baseline.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; const d=JSON.parse(cli(["preview","--format","json"])); assert.equal(d.release_targets.length,1); assert.equal(d.release_targets[0].version,"1.2.1"); assert.equal(d.released_packages.length,1);'
checks.why: A config that validates yet plans zero Go packages fails the user's task.
